policy.check: accepted fixtures must pass check on native and python; rejected fixtures must fail both with the recorded code and leave no program.
policy.native: accepted fixtures build and run at O0 and O2; an allocation-observer link checks every Vec allocation is released (zero live objects). requires_vec_allocations cases must allocate at least one Vec.
policy.python: accepted fixtures build and run with Python 3.12 and are imported through the existing ownership observer to check live language owners and Vec frees.
policy.expected: runtime_expected is an independent main-return value. Exit 0 alone is not accepted as cleanup evidence.
